_note: Income limits are percentages of the federal poverty level (FPL). Update these every January when HHS publishes new poverty guidelines, and check Texas HHS for program changes. The app only gives guidance; the official application decides eligibility.

poverty_guidelines.source: U.S. Department of Health and Human Services, 2026 Poverty Guidelines

chip.name: CHIP (Children's Health Insurance Program)
chip.who: Children and teens under 19 whose family earns too much for Medicaid
chip.cost: Low enrollment fee and copays for some families

pregnancy_medicaid.name: Medicaid for Pregnant Women
pregnancy_medicaid.who: People who are pregnant. Coverage continues for 12 months after the baby is born.
pregnancy_medicaid.source: Medicaid.gov, Medicaid & CHIP eligibility levels (Texas); 12-month postpartum coverage: Texas HHSC, January 2024

healthy_texas_women.name: Healthy Texas Women
healthy_texas_women.who: Women ages 15 to 44 who are not pregnant and don't have other coverage for family planning. A parent or guardian applies for ages 15 to 17.
healthy_texas_women.cost: Free women's health and family planning services
healthy_texas_women.source: Texas Works Handbook W-110, Healthy Texas Women

parent_medicaid.name: Medicaid for Parents and Caretakers
parent_medicaid.who: Very low-income parents or relatives caring for a child
parent_medicaid.source: Medicaid.gov, Medicaid & CHIP eligibility levels (Texas); Texas uses a dollar amount that works out to about 12% FPL

marketplace.name: Health Insurance Marketplace (HealthCare.gov)
marketplace.who: People without job-based coverage, Medicaid, or Medicare
marketplace.cost: Monthly premium; tax credits lower it for incomes between 100% and 400% FPL
marketplace.open_enrollment: November 1, 2026 to January 15, 2027 (enroll by December 15 for coverage starting January 1)
marketplace.source: HealthCare.gov; enhanced subsidies ended after 2025, so the 400% FPL limit applies again

medicare.name: Medicare
medicare.who: People 65 and older, and some younger people with disabilities

health_centers.name: Community health centers
health_centers.cost: Fees on a sliding scale based on income; no one is turned away because they can't pay
